title: Check before changing a server
summary: Validate the configuration before an approved reload, then test real routes and assets. A syntax check does not prove the whole website works.
introduction: Validate the configuration before an approved reload, then test real routes and assets. A syntax check does not prove the whole website works. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain check before changing a server
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Validate the configuration before an approved reload, then test real routes and assets. A syntax check does not prove the whole website works.
On installations providing apachectl, this checks the configured syntax. The exact command name can vary by operating system.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
List checks for the home page, a nested route, CSS and a missing page.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not reload or stop an organisation's server as a learning experiment.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).
